text: この　まえも　あったね　きみは　なにしに　ここへ？

structure.jp: この　まえも　あったね
structure.en: we met the other day too, didn't we

structure.jp: きみは　なにしに　ここへ？
structure.en: what did you come here to do?

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に after the short form of a verb (し from する) means 'in order to do it', used with coming or going. The verb 'come' is left out here. なにしに = 'to do what'.
